notes.title: Monsters still Love You in 2017!
notes.content:
We've put a [i]monsterous[/i] amount of work into our latest update! We could scare you upright with all the [i]terrifying[/i] details of [b]complete engine replacement[/b] and dazzle you with the [i]romantic[/i] mystery of [b]bug-hunting[/b], but you probably just want the straight facts. You know, about the [i]lovely[/i] stuff that you, Friend of Monsters, can enjoy.

[list]
[*] Full gamepad and steam streaming support. You can now sit on your couch comfortably and scroll through the game without mouse or keyboard! Fun for the whole family (or house parties?!)
[*] Full touchscreen support while we're at it. We hear those tablet computers are a hot thing in those human cities!
[*] Full native Linux support! Maybe we will make a joke about a penguin in a tuxdeo here... No? Too forced?
[*] Thanks to the completely new engine on the back-end, your monsterly adventures will be running faster, smoother, and with at least [i]three[/i] more fidelities than were ever previously possible!
[/list]

Note: This new version will unfortunately dissolve your last saved adventure into the goo pits for future monster generations. If you really want to finish off that one last quest, you can revert to the "Classic" edition in Steam's properties menu (under the betas tab).

notes.title: Major update!
notes.content:
[list]
   [*] Added Mac OS X support
   [*] 30 new adventures: Do Gritmitten or Balfog get to keep the cat? Or does each of them get half? What do you do with a desiccated skeleton? And what happens when that grizzly bear you've been tracking turns out to be a real, live Human?
[/list]
